To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of TiC and TiB2 reinforcements in different percentages of Al matrix composites were prepared using stir casting method and analysed mechanical characterization.
the TiC reinforced aluminum composite shows the better mechanical properties than TiB2 reinforced aluminum composite.
the mechanical characterization of aluminium metal matrix composites reinforced with Titanium carbide and boride using stir casting process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of aluminium metal matrix composites (AMMCs) with TiC and TiB2 reinforcements.
the preparation, characterization and wear characteristics of aluminum matrix composites reinforced with TiC and TiB2 particles.
a new method of preparing a composite material based on aluminum alloy reinforced with TiC and TiB2.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the TiC is better reinforcement than TiB2 in aluminum matrix composites for mechanical properties and wear characteristics.
, the TiC reinforced aluminum composites are more suitable for the automotive and aeronautical applications than TiB2 reinforced aluminum composites.
the mechanical and wear properties of aluminum metal matrix composites reinforced with TiC and TiB2 are better when the percentage of reinforcement increased.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of TiC and TiB2 particles in aluminum metal matrix composites has a significant impact on the properties of composites.
, the composites of Al/TiC and Al/TiB2 are having good mechanical and wear characteristics and it can be used as a structural material.
the addition of Titanium Carbide and Titanium borides as reinforcement in the Aluminum alloy matrix has a positive effect on the mechanical properties of the composite material.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TiC reinforced composites are having higher strength and TiB2 reinforced composites are good for friction.
the addition of Titanium carbide in aluminum composites is better than Titanium boride in aluminum compositions.
TiC reinforced aluminum composites are better than TiB2 reinforced aluminum composites in mechanical and wear characteristics.
